goals: Verify that the Delete Workshop API successfully deletes the specified workshop and returns a 200 success response.
Verify that deleting a specific workshop does not affect other existing workshops in the database.
activities: Insert a first test workshop named 'qaRHR_name1'
Insert a second test workshop named 'qaRHR_name2'
Send a DELETE request to the API using the ID of the first workshop
Verify the response status code is 200
Verify the response Content-Type header is 'application/json'
Verify the response body status is 200
Verify the response body message indicates success
Verify the response body data matches the expected data for the first workshop
Verify 'detail' is not present in the response body
Verify the first workshop no longer exists in the database by its ID
Verify the second workshop data remains intact in the database by its ID
Clean the workshop test environment during teardown
